title: mangifera merrillii
intro: Mangifera merrillii, commonly known as the Philippine mango or wild mango, is a species of mango native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its rich nutritional content and potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Mangifera merrillii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully explore the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Mangifera merrillii, but it is currently used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues.
